topic: 7 Things I Wish I Knew Before Lifting

slides.text: 7 things I wish I knew before lifting
save this. you'll need it at the gym

1- Triceps
train heavy, don't need a ton of exercises. two good ones cover it, like tricep extension and JM press.

2- Chest
incline and fly cover it. don't push bench to failure. fatigue stacks and your injury risk goes up.

bigger than all that: get a plan and actually track your progress
try the app

3- Back
lighten the weight, up the reps. form matters more than anything here. control it and stay focused.

4- Biceps
cable work's great cause the tension stays constant. incline curl and spider curl.

5- Legs
train quads, hamstrings, and calves hard, but don't go to failure every set. save that for the last set only.

6- Abs
train them with leg day. abs are just another muscle, don't need some long complicated routine.

7- Shoulders
lateral raise: stay stable, high reps. shoulder press: don't be scared of heavy weight if your form's solid. and don't skip rear delts.
